description: This PHP source file defines the LocaleConfigSubscriber class in the Drupal locale module. It subscribes to configuration change events to update locale translation strings, ensuring user modifications are preserved and translations are synchronized with configuration updates.

classes.name: LocaleConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A class that listens to configuration change events to update locale translation strings accordingly, supporting customization and preservation of user translations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration factory and locale configuration manager.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, including configuration save, delete, and override events.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Handles configuration save events to update locale storage if not during installation or locale updates.

methods.name: onOverrideChange
methods.description: Handles configuration override save/delete events to update locale storage accordingly.

methods.name: updateLocaleStorage
methods.description: Updates locale translation data based on configuration or override changes, checking support and translatability.

methods.name: processTranslatableData
methods.description: Recursively processes translatable data arrays to save or reset translations based on configuration data.

methods.name: resetExistingTranslations
methods.description: Resets existing locale translations to their source strings for specified configuration items.

methods.name: saveCustomizedTranslation
methods.description: Saves a translation string as customized, avoiding overwrites during installation and handling translation updates.
